$comment: Negative half of a pair whose positive half already exists as bundle-005-extensions-accepted (RFC-AITP-0001 §7 for the session bundle's INNER `session_bundle` body). `coordinator_note` is placed as a SIBLING of the body's schema-defined fields, not inside `extensions` — the case RFC-AITP-0012 does not reserve, and distinct from bundle-004 (which tests `signature` misplaced OUTSIDE the body entirely, a wrapper-level defect with its own SESSION_BUNDLE_INVALID code). `aitp-session-bundle.schema.json` sets `additionalProperties: false` on the inner `session_bundle` object, so this is a schema-level rejection. Body is otherwise byte-identical to bundle-001/bundle-005's shape, so the unknown field is the only defect under test.
description: Session Trust Bundle's inner `session_bundle` body carries one unrecognized member (`coordinator_note`) beside its known, schema-defined fields — not inside `extensions`. RFC-AITP-0001 §7: unknown JSON fields outside `extensions` MUST be rejected — silently ignoring the field would create signature ambiguity, since the bundle signing input is the JCS-canonical inner body excluding only `signature` (RFC-AITP-0010 §3), and a verifier that drops the unrecognized member before recomputing the canonical form would accept bytes a strict peer would reject. Receivers MUST reject with UNKNOWN_FIELD. Counterpart: bundle-005-extensions-accepted, which places a member INSIDE `extensions` and succeeds. `input.coordinator_manifest` (the coordinator's signed Manifest) is carried so every bundle fixture has the same input shape; it is never consulted, because the structural rejection precedes coordinator key resolution (RFC-AITP-0010 §5).

expected.rationale: `coordinator_note` is not a member `aitp-session-bundle.schema.json` defines for the inner `session_bundle` body and it is not inside `extensions`, so RFC-AITP-0001 §7's MUST-reject applies. The bundle is otherwise identical to bundle-001/bundle-005's valid shape; the unknown sibling field is the only defect under test.
